title: The Principle of Cognitive Dissonance
text:
Cognitive dissonance describes the mental discomfort experienced when an individual holds two or more contradictory beliefs, ideas, or values. This state of psychological stress is powerful and inherently motivating, driving individuals to resolve the conflict in favor of consistency.

The mind seeks internal equilibrium; therefore, when a discrepancy exists between action and belief, tension arises. Resolution typically occurs by changing one of the conflicting cognitions (e.g., admitting the contradictory belief is wrong) or by rationalizing the inconsistency through the introduction of new supporting beliefs.
